home.tagline: Take {team} from Nice N Sleazys to The Barras. Eight Glasgow venues. One wrong answer and it's over.

how.road: Each venue on the {game} is one question: {stages}. Get it right and the band move on to a bigger stage.
how.knockout: One wrong answer and the {game} is over. Play the last venue and you're a {champion}, with a {prize} to show for it.
how.lifeline: Use it once to remove two wrong answers. Choose the moment carefully: you don't get another one if you play on into a new tour.
how.seasons: Play The Barras and you can start a new tour, going straight in at {restart}. Keep going to add more {prizes}. A wrong answer ends your run, but you keep the {prizes} you've won.
how.top100: The Top 40 is shared with players everywhere, and anyone can add their name and town to it. The most {prizes} ranks highest, then the furthest venue reached. After that, players who didn't use the 50:50 rank above those who did, then the fastest time wins.
how.sound: Hear the crowd roar when you get an answer right. On a phone, the silent switch or volume may also need turning up.
